'''Ryenne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who was a member of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] for five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before becoming a [[Unidentified resistance group (backwater planet)|resistance fighter]] on an [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater planet]]. Ryenne's group joined with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|raid]] the [[Imperial communications hub]] at [[Sunfall Peak]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ryenne appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]]. Ryenne was also later used as a player's character in an example of gameplay given later in the book.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
